title: Research Methodology In Legislative Drafting
mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a comprehensive list of all literary works and documents consulted during the research including materials that were actually used (cited) and those not cited."
Bibliography The bibliography is a comprehensive list of all literary works and documents consulted during the research including materials that were actually used (cited) and those not cited.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the best forum to present results of such studies."
Usually a conference or workshop is the best forum to present results of such studies.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are the tools and aids at the researcher's disposal."
Equally diverse are the tools and aids at the researcher's disposal.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the primary research option of the legal practitioner as it directly enquires into the state of the law shorn of arguments, or value factors."
Doctrinaire research is the primary research option of the legal practitioner as it directly enquires into the state of the law shorn of arguments, or value factors.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a specialized and highly demanding task."
Library management is a specialized and highly demanding task.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ means the procedure or ways and means by which research is carried out."
Methodology in Research Methodology means the procedure or ways and means by which research is carried out.
fib: ______ are a combination of primary and secondary tools subject to the caution that scant reliance should be placed on secondary tools in order to draw a conclusion of law.
The tools used are a combination of primary and secondary tools subject to the caution that scant reliance should be placed on secondary tools in order to draw a conclusion of law.
______ is the Act passed by the National Assembly or Law passed by a House of Assembly of a State.
A primary legislation is the Act passed by the National Assembly or Law passed by a House of Assembly of a State.
______ is the primary laboratory of legal research.
The law library is the primary laboratory of legal research.
______ are the description of the methodology, the findings and acknowledgment of sources (bibliography) including recommendations.
The important elements are the description of the methodology, the findings and acknowledgment of sources (bibliography) including recommendations.
______ is the formal acknowledgment and identification of data opinions and various other materials that have contributed to the overall quality of the research.
Documentation is the formal acknowledgment and identification of data opinions and various other materials that have contributed to the overall quality of the research.
______ refers to the body of laws itself i.e. the Constitution, Acts, Laws, and case reports.
A primary source refers to the body of laws itself i.e. the Constitution, Acts, Laws, and case reports.
